actor.tool: Connected GitHub source/TA records; web.run primary institutional/publisher indexed Abstract and PubMed, restricted publisher full-text routes; no original PDF bytes, audio or human assessor

data.rule: Frozen v1 §4 E1–E6, §6.2(3), §6.3 and §10: abstract-only/metadata access cannot substantiate full-text eligibility; lawful original full text remains requested
data.reason: The original journal-paper Abstract is readable in PubMed PMID 15204277 and the search-indexed publisher abstract describes pilots and non-pilots rating the perceived urgency of five helicopter auditory alarms. This sustains the previous title/abstract include-to-full-text decision only. Original Taylor & Francis full article (Methods/Results, acoustical specification and participant identity) returned HTTP 403 in a direct request on 2026-11-10, so frozen §6.2(3)/§6.3 require awaiting_text, not an evidence-based exclusion or inclusion. The pilots and non-pilots, five stimuli, rating and ranking tasks do not establish independent studies or samples. No original audio was heard.
data.access_limitation: Verified DOI 10.1080/0014013042000193282; Ergonomics volume 47 issue 8 pages 821-840 in 2004; publisher online posting 2007-02-20 is not a new publication. PubMed original-paper Abstract https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15204277/ and publisher abstract index https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/0014013042000193282 were accessed through public web reading 2026-11-10; full-article request https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/0014013042000193282 returned 403 Forbidden. Current web index of the publisher abstract is not its full article. No full Methods/Results, original PDF/audio, original HTTP Date, raw source bytes/SHA-256, local custody/redistribution grant, retained manuscript or independent human assessment. Source SRC@1 remains metadata_only with no manifestations; R005 source access observations in Draft PR #148 are separate and not accepted as source reading.
